generation.free_design:
Place: A modern apartment reading nook at night, with an amber floor lamp and dark bay window.
Activity: She reaches for the little prism at the end of a chapter and splashes a rectangle of lamplight across the wall; as she lifts it the separate shoulder bolero rotates on its fastening, revealing the upper back above a secure bodice.
Pose: She stands nearly front-on near the window, right hand holding the prism at cheek height, left forearm resting on the wide sill with her hand visible.
Framing: An eye-level waist-up portrait showing her face and both hands in the lamp glow with the reflected color behind her.
Outfit: A lingerie-inspired evening ensemble with a fully lined blackberry bustier with scalloped seamwork, matching high-waisted tap shorts, and a detachable asymmetric satin bolero on a single ring fastening.
